Advances: specled.package

Surfaced by the specled_-j3k auditor (2026-07-25). skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/task-templates.md:30 and :66 instruct replacing the <PROJECT_VERIFICATION_COMMAND> placeholder in the scaffolded .spec/AGENTS.md — but priv/spec_init/AGENTS.md.eex contains no such placeholder (same N13-class falsehood fixed in adoption-phases.md by specled_-j3k commit ee60621). task-templates.md now contradicts the corrected adoption-phases.md wording ('the scaffolded template ships without one and has no placeholder to replace, so add the line').

Deliverable: reword both task-templates.md sites to say the verification-command line must be ADDED to the scaffolded AGENTS.md (no placeholder exists), matching adoption-phases.md phase0 done-criteria wording. Whole-file sweep of task-templates.md for any other scaffold-content claims while there (verify each against priv/spec_init/ before changing).

## Spec co-change authorization

Editing .spec/specs/package.spec.md and the tool-managed baseline .spec/realization_hashes.json (via its documented regeneration path) is IN SCOPE when the spec gate demands co-change for the touched skill surface. This authorization comes before any scope warning below.

## Allowed touches

- skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/task-templates.md
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md
- .spec/realization_hashes.json

## Out of Scope (files)

- lib/**, test/**, priv/** — docs-only ticket; priv/spec_init/ is read-only reference truth here
- skills/spec-led-bootstrap/SKILL.md, references/adoption-phases.md, references/detection-matrix.md — already corrected by specled_-j3k / specled_-xde
- docs/**

## Out of Scope (intent)

- No severity/default claims changes beyond the placeholder wording
- No code changes
- Scaffold-content claims corrected ONLY when verified false against priv/spec_init/ (verify each against the actual template before changing)

## Verification

- mix spec.check --no-run-commands --base <base> passes with the specled.package subject co-changed or unchanged-as-appropriate
- grep -r PROJECT_VERIFICATION_COMMAND skills/ returns nothing
- Both former placeholder sites (~:30, ~:66) now instruct ADDING the verification-command line to the scaffolded AGENTS.md, matching adoption-phases.md phase0 done-criteria wording
